name: hep-demo/v1
purpose: Acceptance profile for a collider-event DEMO scene (not a precision study, not a STEM-grade physics claim). Accepting under it means: every listed event file parses, its units are sane (no MeV read as GeV, no millimetres read as metres), its charge adds up, its momenta roughly balance the declared incoming, every helix bends the way its pT, charge and the field say (declared, measured on the hits, and as drawn in the scene), everything drawn sits inside the declared detector, every visible particle above the declared cuts is drawn exactly once and every drawn track and tower maps to the event (one Shape per track, or one strip per track in a merged set whose declared ribbon offset is taken off), only muons are drawn past the calorimeter and every muon that leaves the tracker is, every drawn track carries the shared shader, its per-track vertex attributes (id, charge, pT, birth time, species, arc length) and a clock route from a TimeSensor, and the repository's own traps witness finds none of its eleven known traps in the scenes. It says nothing about masses, resonances, calorimeter sums, how the shaders compile or look, frame rate, or whether the physics is right.

gate_map.HEP-PARSE: hepevent: EVT_PARSE (event JSON, mothers, numbers, scene XML, USE before DEF, unreadable nodes)
gate_map.HEP-SPEC: hepevent: EVT_SPEC (the thresholds live in the spec file, validated before use)
gate_map.HEP-UNITS: hepevent: EVT_UNITS (median mass of known particles, detector size, helix radius and scene extent against their expected scale)
gate_map.HEP-CHARGE: hepevent: EVT_CHARGE (final-state charge against the declared incoming; track against its particle)
gate_map.HEP-4MOM: hepevent: EVT_4MOM (loose: final-state four-momentum against the declared incoming and the beams)
gate_map.HEP-CURVATURE: hepevent: EVT_CURVATURE (curvature = 0.2998 B / pT, on the declared helix, the hits and the drawn polyline; a path whose expected bend is below the rounding of its points is judged as a straight line and counted as unresolved)
gate_map.HEP-SENSE: hepevent: EVT_SENSE (clockwise or counter-clockwise from charge and field direction)
gate_map.HEP-CONTAINMENT: hepevent: EVT_CONTAINMENT (hits, vertices, drawn track points and drawn tower corners inside the declared volumes; muon extensions inside the declared muon system, and only for the declared pdg codes)
gate_map.HEP-BIJECTION: hepevent: EVT_SCENE_BIJECTION (every drawable particle drawn once; every trk_ and twr_ shape, or trkset_/muext_/twrset_ strip, maps to the event; none hidden or drawn twice; a merged shape is read only under a declared scene.merged convention; an exiting muon must continue through the calorimeter)
gate_map.HEP-SHADER: hepevent: EVT_SHADER (shader bound, data: URLs, attributes supplied with the right count and values, both edges of a ribbon agree, tower cell energy matches the event, clock routed)
gate_map.HEP-TRAPS: traps: the eleven recorded traps (shader-raw-source, glsl-reserved-active, route-before-def, version-fits-nodes, ...)
gate_map.HEP-FAIL-CLOSED: every predicate raises; tested under python -O (kit/tests/test_hepevent.py)

limitations: 15 to 17 percent of the charged tracks in the real events (mostly very forward ones) draw a bend smaller than 0.3 mm over the tracker; the witness cannot measure that bend and says so (scene_curvature_unresolved, unresolved_hits). Those paths are checked only for being straight to within the expected sagitta plus three rounding steps.
A demo profile: tolerances are loose and declared in the spec; a precision study would add mass-shell, resonance and calorimeter sum-rule codes, not tighten these.

Nothing here renders the scene or compiles the GLSL: grammar and meaning need the X3D fork, behaviour needs a browser, the look-match against the reference still is an eye witness. All four stay visibly not run.
The shaders were written for X_ITE's WebGL and checked lexically only (no '#', '%', quotes or '//', no 'active', no integer literals, balanced brackets).
The detector response is a truth-level toy (kit/examples/hep/hep_response.py): tracks, hits and towers are placed from the generator's particles, not simulated.
Unsigned receipt: it shows drift; it does not authenticate authorship.
version_note: v1 (2026-11-06): the candidate carries every fixture twice, in look v1 (events/, one Shape per track) and look v2 (events-v2/, ribbons merged into strips, muon extensions, tower spikes), so coverage is 8 events and 8 scenes; the witness reads look v2 through the merged convention the spec declares (scene.merged). v0 covered look v1 only and was never published.
